Subject: Data retention exception request  FinTech Solutions

Hi Alice,

Great talking with you this morning  thanks for taking the time. Per our discovery call, I wanted to summarize the key points and confirm next steps on the retention and PII requirements so I can loop in Security/Legal.

Recap of the ask:
- FinTech wants zero retention (no request/response bodies stored) for any PII from production user traffic.
- You still need audit-level logs for operational metrics (anonymized) and access/audit trails for 12–24 months; audit logs may contain non-PII metadata for troubleshooting.
- Data residency requirement: primary processing and storage in eu-west-1 (Ireland).
- You will be sending our standard security questionnaire and would like SOC2 evidence and a short statement on logging controls.

Questions we need to confirm from your side:
1) Can you confirm whether 0-retention needs to apply to all environments (prod/staging) or only production?
2) Do you have a strict timeline for when the retention exception needs to be contractually effective?
3) Any additional legal constraints (e.g., regulatory obligations requiring retention for a subset of records)?

What we can do next:
- I can draft a proposed exception clause and an implementation approach (config to disable request/response persistence for this tenant, and a shortened metrics retention policy).
- Loop in our Security and Legal (cc'd Rafael and I will loop Marissa) to validate from a compliance standpoint.
- Share SOC2 artifact and a redline of the proposed exception for your review.

Attachments: redline_data_retention_exception.docx (draft), SOC2_summary.pdf (summary)

Proposed next step: quick 30-min call with your security/legal and our Security (Marissa) early next week to finalize language. Are you available Tue/Wed morning PST?

Thanks  looking forward to getting this locked down.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Thanks Camila  appreciate the recap. Quick answers below:  

- 0-retention must apply to production traffic only (we can allow staging/dev to have standard short-term logs for debugging).
- We require that any PII (user identifiers, names, addresses, SSN-like tokens) be excluded from persistent logs and not stored after request processing. That means request/response bodies for production must not be retained.
- We do need an exceptions approach for auditability: anonymized event metrics and non-PII telemetry retained for 30 days, and security/audit logs (who accessed admin consoles, configuration changes) retained for 365 days in encrypted storage.
- Data residency: yes, primary processing and storage must be in EU (Ireland).
- Timeline: we need contractual language in the MSA before pilot starts (targeting May 15).

I will send our security questionnaire now (attached) and loop Legal on contract language. Please make sure your security team confirms you can turn off request/response persistence for our tenant and confirm where the audit logs will be stored and for how long.

Thanks,
Alice
Head of Platform Security | FinTech Solutions
alice@fintechsolutions.com

Thanks Alice  this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from our side and how we typically handle these exceptions:

Implementation options (summary):
- Hosted (standard): by default we keep request/response bodies for 30 days for debugging; not acceptable for your production need.
- Hosted with tenant-level 0-retention flag: we can configure a tenant setting to disable persistence of request/response bodies for production traffic (responses streamed and not written to persistent storage). This still allows ephemeral in-memory processing and we can purge any ephemeral caches immediately.
- Dedicated/Private: for customers requiring contractual guarantees + data residency, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment (customer pinned to EU region + ability to control logs retention policies).

Security controls we will include in the proposed exception language:
- Explicit 0-retention for request/response bodies for production tenant.
- Anonymized telemetry retention: 30 days (rolled up metrics only).
- Audit/security logs retention: 365 days, encrypted at rest with customer KMS option.
- Access controls and audit trail for any support access (we can provide detailed logs of support sessions but redact request/response body).

Next steps we propose:
1) I'll draft the exception clause and share a redline to your Legal (attached) for review by EOD today.
2) Schedule a 30-min call with your Security + our Security (cc Marissa)  can we do Mon/Tue next week?
3) If Legal is comfortable, we can add the clause to the MSA and prepare a short SOW for pilot.

Please confirm availability for the call and if your Legal needs any additional artifact (full SOC2 report, penetration test summary, or config docs).

Thanks,
Camila

Quick internal note before we present to Legal: we can approve a tenant-level 0-retention configuration for production request/response bodies for FinTech Solutions under the following conditions:
- The exception is contractually scoped to this customer only and automatically reviewed annually.
- No customer-supplied models or custom model training on customer data are permitted under the exception.
- We require a 36-month minimum term for the exception, with an exit & remediation plan.
- Additional evidentiary artifacts required: full SOC2 report (available), recent pen test summary, and attestation that FinTech will not request data exports containing PII.

If Legal agrees, we will prepare proposed contract language and an SOW. Rafael  can you confirm feasibility on the KMS integration for EU-region key control and the option to store audit logs in customer-provided bucket?
